advanced-filters.purpose: Compose dashboard, audit, and table filters with saved views, active chips, reset behavior, validation, and responsive overflow.
useWhen: Users need more than one filter dimension for dashboards or data tables.
Active filters need to remain visible and removable.
Filters affect charts, tables, exports, or saved views.
doNotUseWithoutReview: A single field or Select is enough.
Filter source, default values, or reset behavior is unclear.
Filters change regulated reports without review or audit.
foundations: Defines filter bar density, chip wrapping, drawer fallback, and panel spacing.
Owns filter labels, empty copy, reset copy, saved-view names, and validation.
Controls active filter emphasis, disabled state, and validation tone.
Default, dirty, applied, loading, disabled, empty, invalid, and saved states are explicit.
Overflow panels and mobile drawers use Design System overlay depth.
Filter labels, active count, removal, reset, and validation are keyboard accessible.
slots: Filter inputs for entity, status, date, or keyword.
Visible active filters with count and removal.
Apply, reset, save view, or export actions.
Controls that do not fit in the primary bar.
Invalid range, saved view, or applied state feedback.
variants: Dense controls plus active filter chips.
Save/apply named filter sets after explicit action.
Overflow filters move to Drawer on constrained viewports.
motion: Results update after explicit action or declared immediate behavior.
Removal updates count without shifting the whole toolbar.
Menu/Drawer uses Design System overlay motion and reduced-motion fallback.
accessibility: Every filter has a programmatic label.
Invalid filter combinations are explained in text.
tests: Apply updates active chips and count.
Small viewport keeps filters reachable through overflow or drawer.

canDecide: Use Advanced Filters when multiple dimensions affect dashboard or table data.
Use active chips to show applied state.
Move overflow into Menu or Drawer based on viewport.
mustAsk: Default filters, saved-view ownership, analytics, export behavior, or audit policy is unclear.
Filters affect financial, compliance, or regulated reporting.
rejectIf: Controls are hardcoded instead of Design System inputs.
miel.handoff: Confirm filter dimensions, defaults, apply mode, saved views, reset rules, export impact, and responsive overflow.
